description: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Build under pressure. Bid for power. Adapt to the unexpected. Then defend your solution. Pitch//Break is a two-day competition where teams build a solution, earn and spend points, adapt to challenges, and face off against rival teams. Every decision matters: earn points through your performance, use Power Cards strategically, and avoid faults that cost you points. The team with the highest score at the end wins. Event timeline Day 1 · 21 October Round 1: Initial Solution Build Submit your team’s initial solution. This gives the judges a starting point for your team’s journey in the arena. Round 2: Power Card Auction — Bid with your existing points to acquire Power Cards. Choose carefully: the right card could change your game. Round 3: Challenge — Adapt your solution to a new challenge. Show the judges how well your team can think on its feet. Day 2 · 22 October Round 4: New Solution Pitch — Present your solution to the judges and earn points for your pitch. Round 5: Sponsor Challenge — Take on a sponsor-led mini quiz or challenge to earn more points. Final Round: Team vs Team — Surviving teams are paired to challenge each other’s solutions and pitches. Use any Power Cards you have. Judges decide the winner of each face-off; faults or failures in your solution cost points. The team with the most points wins. What’s at stake? ₹50,000 prize pool 2 remote internship opportunities Swag and certificates for participants Event details Dates: 21–22 October 2026 Venue: A005 Lecture Hall, USAR · GGSIPU East Delhi Campus Team size: 1–4 members Bring a team that can build, adapt, pitch, and hold its ground. Register now and enter the arena.
organiser: University School of Automation & Robotics (USAR), GGSIPU EDC

PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA

Build under pressure. Bid for power. Adapt to the unexpected. Then defend your solution.

Pitch//Break is a two-day competition where teams build a solution, earn and spend points, adapt to challenges, and face off against rival teams. Every decision matters: earn points through your performance, use Power Cards strategically, and avoid faults that cost you points. The team with the highest score at the end wins.

Event timeline

Day 1 · 21 October

  • Round 1: Initial Solution Build
    Submit your team’s initial solution. This gives the judges a starting point for your team’s journey in the arena.

  • Round 2: Power Card Auction — Bid with your existing points to acquire Power Cards. Choose carefully: the right card could change your game.
  • Round 3: Challenge — Adapt your solution to a new challenge. Show the judges how well your team can think on its feet.

Day 2 · 22 October

  • Round 4: New Solution Pitch — Present your solution to the judges and earn points for your pitch.
  • Round 5: Sponsor Challenge — Take on a sponsor-led mini quiz or challenge to earn more points.
  • Final Round: Team vs Team — Surviving teams are paired to challenge each other’s solutions and pitches. Use any Power Cards you have. Judges decide the winner of each face-off; faults or failures in your solution cost points.

The team with the most points wins.

What’s at stake?

  • ₹50,000 prize pool
  • 2 remote internship opportunities
  • Swag and certificates for participants

Event details

Dates: 21–22 October 2026
Venue: A005 Lecture Hall, USAR · GGSIPU East Delhi Campus
Team size: 1–4 members

Bring a team that can build, adapt, pitch, and hold its ground. Register now and enter the arena.
